name: add_central_learning_progression
query: ALTER TABLE public.user_progress ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress', ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS started_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_viewed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS completed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE public.user_progress DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS user_progress_status_check; ALTER TABLE public.user_progress ADD CONSTRAINT user_progress_status_check CHECK (status IN ('in_progress','completed')); ALTER TABLE public.user_progress DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS user_progress_study_seconds_check; ALTER TABLE public.user_progress ADD CONSTRAINT user_progress_study_seconds_check CHECK (study_seconds >= 0); UPDATE public.user_progress SET status=CASE WHEN completed THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END, started_at=coalesce(started_at,updated_at,now()), last_viewed_at=coalesce(last_viewed_at,updated_at,now()), completed_at=CASE WHEN completed THEN coalesce(completed_at,updated_at,now()) ELSE NULL END; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS user_progress_user_last_viewed_idx ON public.user_progress (user_id,last_viewed_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS user_progress_lesson_status_idx ON public.user_progress (lesson_id,status); ALTER TABLE public.user_progress ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(p_lesson_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.levels lv ON lv.name=p.school_level JOIN public.series sr ON sr.name=p.series JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id=lv.id AND o.series_id=sr.id AND o.is_published IS TRUE JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id AND l.is_active IS TRUE WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND l.id=p_lesson_id); $$; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS insert_own_progress ON public.user_progress; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS update_own_progress ON public.user_progress; CREATE POLICY insert_own_accessible_progress ON public.user_progress FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid()=user_id AND public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(lesson_id)); CREATE POLICY update_own_accessible_progress ON public.user_progress FOR UPDATE USING ((auth.uid()=user_id) OR public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (((auth.uid()=user_id) AND public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(lesson_id)) OR public.is_admin()); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_lesson_view(p_lesson_id uuid) RETURNS public.user_progress LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ DECLARE result_row public.user_progress; BEGIN IF NOT public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(p_lesson_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'La leçon demandée n’est pas disponible pour votre profil scolaire.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.user_progress (user_id,lesson_id,completed,progress_percentage,status,started_at,last_viewed_at,completed_at,study_seconds,updated_at) VALUES (auth.uid(),p_lesson_id,false,0,'in_progress',now(),now(),NULL,0,now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id,lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET last_viewed_at=now(), updated_at=now(), status=CASE WHEN public.user_progress.status='completed' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END RETURNING * INTO result_row; RETURN result_row; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_lesson_for_current_student(p_lesson_id uuid) RETURNS public.user_progress LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ DECLARE result_row public.user_progress; BEGIN IF NOT public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(p_lesson_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'La leçon demandée n’est pas disponible pour votre profil scolaire.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.user_progress (user_id,lesson_id,completed,progress_percentage,status,started_at,last_viewed_at,completed_at,study_seconds,updated_at) VALUES (auth.uid(),p_lesson_id,true,100,'completed',now(),now(),now(),0,now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id,lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET completed=true, progress_percentage=100, status='completed', completed_at=coalesce(public.user_progress.completed_at,now()), last_viewed_at=now(), updated_at=now() RETURNING * INTO result_row; RETURN result_row; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_course_progress() RETURNS TABLE(offering_id uuid, subject_id uuid, subject_name text, subject_description text, offering_display_order integer, chapter_id uuid, chapter_title text, chapter_description text, chapter_display_order integer, lesson_id uuid, lesson_title text, lesson_display_order integer, progress_status text, started_at timestamptz, last_viewed_at timestamptz, completed_at timestamptz, study_seconds integer, is_favorite boolean) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT o.id, s.id, s.name, s.description, o.display_order, c.id, c.title, c.description, c.display_order, l.id, l.title, l.display_order, up.status, up.started_at, up.last_viewed_at, up.completed_at, coalesce(up.study_seconds,0), (f.id IS NOT NULL) FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.levels lv ON lv.name=p.school_level JOIN public.series sr ON sr.name=p.series JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id=lv.id AND o.series_id=sr.id AND o.is_published IS TRUE JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id AND l.is_active IS TRUE LEFT JOIN public.user_progress up ON up.user_id=auth.uid() AND up.lesson_id=l.id LEFT JOIN public.favorites f ON f.user_id=auth.uid() AND f.content_type='lesson' AND f.content_id=l.id WHERE p.id=auth.uid() ORDER BY o.display_order,c.display_order,l.display_order; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_progress_overview() RETURNS TABLE(students_started bigint, lesson_starts bigint, lesson_completions bigint, average_completion_percentage numeric) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Accès administrateur requis.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; RETURN QUERY SELECT count(DISTINCT up.user_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE up.status IN ('in_progress','completed')), count(*) FILTER (WHERE up.status='completed'), coalesce(round(avg(CASE WHEN up.status='completed' THEN 100::numeric ELSE 0::numeric END),1),0::numeric) FROM public.user_progress up; END; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.record_lesson_view(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.complete_lesson_for_current_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_course_progress() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_admin_progress_overview() FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_lesson_view(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.complete_lesson_for_current_student(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_course_progress() TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_admin_progress_overview() TO authenticated;
